content.rendered:
“The Time In Between” is a masterpiece of minimalism, a meta-commentary on the moments that separate the tracks on an album.

Or the posts on a blog.

Okay, I admit it: I need a break today to recover from jetlag, so just enjoy this scrap of a song that never was, recorded by Bruce at home home in in late 1979. See you tomorrow!

The Time in Between
Recorded: Late 1979
Never released
Never performed

© October 13, 2018

excerpt.rendered: “The Time in Between” never grew from its seed, but we can wonder what might have been.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Find It Where You Can
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Missing in action: this early lyrical forerunner to "Tougher Than the Rest" made it all the way to an E Street Band rehearsal but never to the studio.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Everybody’s Looking for Somebody
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Everybody's looking for *something*, but I'll be darned if I can figure out what. Give this brief home demo a listen and see if you can figure out what Bruce is singing about.

jetpack-related-posts.title: I Wanna Start a New Life
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: This gorgeous Jackson Browne-ian work-in-progress ballad might have made for a gorgeous song had Bruce completed it.

jetpack-related-posts.title: I Don’t Know
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce recorded a home demo of "I Don't Know" in 1979. What's it about? Like the song says...

jetpack-related-posts.title: You Gotta Fight (For What You Want)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Possibly a precursor to "Two Hearts," "You Gotta Fight (For What You Want)" provides a peek into the reggae-inspired early home demos that led to Bruce's 1980 album, The River.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Mr. Outside
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The curious case of a bootleg turned official release (and the mystery of why bother).
